# PICO and eligibility {#sec-pico}

| Element | Specification |
|---|---|
| **P** | Adults with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, 1–4 prior lines, lenalidomide-exposed or refractory, no prior BCMA-directed therapy (primary analysis) |
| **I** | Cilta-cel; ide-cel; teclistamab + daratumumab; elranatamab; talquetamab + daratumumab ± pomalidomide; teclistamab + talquetamab; talquetamab + pomalidomide |
| **C** | DPd, PVd, DVd, EPd, Rd, Kd — modelled first as one composite "physician's choice" node |
| **O** | Primary: PFS (HR). Secondary: OS; ORR; ≥CR; MRD negativity; CRS; ICANS; infections; discontinuation |
| **S / design** | Phase 3 RCTs. Randomised phase 2 permitted? **TODO: decide and justify.** |
| **T / data cut** | 2026-11-15; ASH 2026 abstracts flagged as abstract-only |

# Outcomes and definitions {#sec-outcomes}

| Outcome | Type | Measure | Definition to use | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PFS | time-to-event | HR (log scale) | IRC/BICR-assessed where available | Primary |
| OS | time-to-event | HR (log scale) | | Often immature — see §18 |
| ORR | binary | OR | ≥PR | |
| ≥CR | binary | OR | | |
| MRD negativity | binary | OR | State assay and threshold | |
| CRS | binary | OR | State grading system (ASTCT) | |
| ICANS | binary | OR | State grading system | |
| Infections | binary | OR | Grade ≥3 | |
| Discontinuation | binary | OR | Any-cause | |

::: {.callout-warning}
## The trap this table exists to prevent
Mixing PFS definitions (investigator vs IRC), or mixing HR with OR, is one of the
listed failure modes. Pin the definition **per trial** in `outcomes.csv` before
pooling anything.
:::

# Bucher indirect comparison {#sec-bucher}

For two log relative effects $d_{AB}$ and $d_{BC}$, each with standard error $se$:

$$
d_{AC} = d_{AB} - d_{BC}, \qquad
se_{AC} = \sqrt{se_{AB}^2 + se_{BC}^2}, \qquad
CI_{AC} = \exp\!\left(d_{AC} \pm 1.96\, se_{AC}\right)
$$

# Comparator definitions {#sec-comparator}

The central judgement of the project. Three defensible models; **all three are
run**:

1. **Composite SOC node** — every control arm becomes "physician's choice".
2. **Decomposed regimens** — DPd, PVd, DVd, EPd as separate nodes, connected via
   APOLLO, IKARIA-MM, OPTIMISMM and ELOQUENT-3.
3. **Network meta-regression** — keep the composite node, model prior lines and
   prior anti-CD38 exposure as effect modifiers.

<!--

# Transitivity and consistency {#sec-transitivity}

| Trial | Prior anti-CD38 | Len-refractory | Population note |
|---|---|---|---|
| CARTITUDE-4 | ≈24% refractory | Required | Earlier line, less refractory |
| KarMMa-3 | ≈95% refractory | Triple-class exposed | Heavily pretreated; control PFS 4.4 mo |
| MajesTEC-3 | Daratumumab-refractory excluded | Required | Control PFS 18.1 mo |
| MagnetisMM-5 | ≈5.9% prior exposure | Required | Mostly anti-CD38-naïve |
| MonumenTAL-3 | Stratified by prior exposure | Required | Mixed exposure |
| MonumenTAL-6 | Required prior anti-CD38 | Required | Closest to current second-line practice |

- [ ] Decomposed comparator with backbone trials added
- [ ] Abstract-only trials excluded
